channel.title: The Gospel Coalition - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Gospel Coalition (thegospelcoalition.org)

item.title: Lifted Up: Discover John’s View of the Cross
item.description: The cross isn’t only the place of Jesus’s suffering; it’s also the moment when God’s glory is supremely revealed.

item.title: Christians Must Resist Assisted Suicide
item.description: Christians should resist the cultural tide of euthanasia that undermines the value of human life. Instead, we should value God’s gift of life at every stage of human development.

item.title: 5 Reasons You Need Sabbath Rest
item.description: We need to take rest seriously. The Lord invites us to set aside ordinary things and experience the blessing of spiritual things.

item.title: Why Women Need to Study Joshua
item.description: We can’t afford to play favorites with a handful of New Testament books at the expense of the rest of Scripture.

item.title: Today’s Spiritual Trends Are Often Ancient Errors Recycled
item.description: In ‘Magician and Mechanic,’ Michael Horton renews our confidence that the gospel is the church’s enduring answer to modernity’s recycled errors.

item.title: A Tool for Spiritual Formation in a Secular Age
item.description: Trevin Wax and Thomas West join Collin Hansen to discuss how catechisms help believers grow in faith and respond to modern cultural challenges with a biblical perspective.

item.title: Preach for Action, Not Just Information
item.description: Expository preaching isn’t just about repeating propositional facts. It’s about using every imaginative tool available to ensure the action of God’s Word is felt and understood today.

item.title: On My Shelf: Life and Books with Simonetta Carr
item.description: Simonetta Carr talks about what’s on her bedside table, favorite fiction, favorite rereads, and more.

item.title: How to Derail a Bible Study
item.description: Mulling over the world’s blatant shortcomings accomplishes little, but examining our own can help us to be stronger witnesses.

item.title: Why Sports Betting Should Concern Christians
item.description: ‘Everybody Loses’ helps Christians explain why opposition to legalized gambling isn’t legalism; it’s part of loving our neighbors well.
